name: Andou Riho
source:
A second-year university student.

She admires Saegi Reina, who appears in the media and on TV, and wants to be like her, so she applies to the university where Reina is an associate professor.

After her department lectures, she chats with her friends and they get along well enough to go out together.

She currently has no experience with men, but dreams of one day meeting a great man, going on a great date, and having a memorable first experience.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1203286]Getchu[/url]]
